raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Backport of #4079 to `r0.5.0`.

Defaults the b300/b200 llama3_70b and llama31_405b pretrain builders to `config_variant="v2"`, and aliases the 8B/405B B300/B200 V1 (+ 405B V2) presets to their GB300/GB200 counterparts.

Cherry-picked cleanly from the `main` PR; the four touched config files are identical between `main` and `r0.5.0`.

nodes.body:
This pull request requires additional validation before any workflows can run on NVIDIA's runners.

Pull request vetters can view their responsibilities [here](https://docs.gha-runners.nvidia.com/cpr/vetters).

Contributors can view more details about this message [here](https://docs.gha-runners.nvidia.com/cpr/contributors).

Code Review - Bug: Duplicate V2 alias definitions in llama31_workload_base_configs.py. The B300/B200 V2 aliases for LLAMA31_405B are defined twice at lines 231-239 (newly added by this PR) and again at lines 247-255 (pre-existing). Both blocks are identical. Python silently overwrites the first set with the second, so there is no runtime error, but the first block is dead code. One of the two blocks should be removed. Everything else looks correct. Suggested test cases: No perf tests impacted.

Full review details below. The cuda_graph_scope=[] to full_iteration fix in GB200_NVFP4_V1 corrects a type mismatch (list vs Optional[str]). The removal of cuda_graph_scope=[] from the H100 large-scale config is also a type fix. The V1 B300/B200 to GB alias redirects and the default variant bump from v1 to v2 are intentional. The 8B aliases in llama3_workload_base_configs.py are clean with no duplicates. Suggested test cases: No perf tests impacted. Consider adding integration tests for llama3_70b_pretrain_config_b300 (default now v2), llama3_70b_pretrain_config_b200 (default now v2), llama31_405b_pretrain_config_b300 (default now v2), llama31_405b_pretrain_config_b200 (default now v2).
This also affects LLAMA31_405B_PRETRAIN_CONFIG_GB200_NVFP4_V2 which is the main tracked config. Can you update the golden values for LLAMA31_405B_PRETRAIN_CONFIG_GB200_NVFP4_V2?
